Publish.LongDescription:
## Adjust All Speed Limits ...and Paths and Invisible roads now too 🥳
Is a powerful, easy toolkit to fine-tune how fast vehicles travel on any network type.
Open ASL, then click a road, rail, waterway or bike path to open the full panel. Filters, invisible networks and the Paths tab are available there.
## 🌄 Key Features
* **Adjust speeds on individual segments** with a simple click. * **Click-and-drag** over the road/track to modify multiple segments at once. * Works on: * 🚗 **Roads** 🚊 **Trams** 🚆 **Trains** 🚇 **Subway** ⛵ **Waterways** * 🚲 **New: Bike paths + mixed bike/pedestrian paths** — set speeds per segment. * 👁 **New: Invisible networks** — show vanilla dashed markers and edit hidden roads and bike paths. Optional hotkey works even with the panel closed. * **New Options → Bicycles tab:** Bicycle + electric scooter maximum speed (30–1000%, 100% = game default). Acceleration and braking adjust automatically. * **Personal vehicle status:** Bike, scooter, car and parked counts. Hidden-car diagnostic report. Updates in Options only. * **New Paths tab:** separate global speed-limit scales for Bike + mixed paths and Pedestrian-only paths, 30–300% (100% = vanilla). Individual bike-path edits take priority. * Stats are light: only runs when the panel is open, better data than the game's info panel.
## Important
* Remove old "Road Speed Adjuster" (RSA) mod before installing this. Old one is no longer maintained (modder retired). * Existing custom speeds should remain and can be edited/reset per segment in new mod. * Pedestrian-only paths can be adjusted globally (not per segment). This changes path limits, not citizens' maximum walking speed. * Hidden car/vehicle roads are excluded from both global Paths sliders; supported segments can still be edited individually. * Example: Bike 200% changes a 30 km/h default bike path to 60 km/h. Individual edits take priority. * Each Paths tab **Reset** restores its own global multiplier to 100%. Speed Limits **Paths Reset** clears individual bike-path edits so they follow the Bike scale. * Moving from Bikes + Paths? ASL replaces B+P. Remove Bikes + Paths when using ASL; no reset is required. Optional: to restore vanilla values first, use Reset to Game Defaults with B+P alone, let the changes finish and save. Legacy hidden vehicle pathways may retain modified limits otherwise. B+P 1.1.6+ is compatible during the transition; older versions can conflict. * Vehicles are still limited by their max speeds (different for each type). * Removing this mod does not reset your customized speed limits. Any speeds you set will remain on the section until you delete/change the road. * **Use Reset buttons** and then Save City to restore the roads/segments to default speeds. * Performance: floating labels and stats run while ASL is open. Global path changes apply on request or city load, then go idle. Saved speeds use lightweight checks. * ICE-3 trains have a real top speed of 320km/h, so the rail slider allows up to 400km/h (800km/h with doubled display). * The game's Unlimited highway policy is 200km/h normally, or 400km/h with "Show Game Doubled Speeds".
## Support and Feedback * Support by clicking the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. It takes weeks and months to make these level of mods and many hours with testers. * For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [Github](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-AllSpeedLimits) links on this page. PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license.
## ❤️ Credits and Special Thanks Huge appreciation hugs and waves to everyone
* River-mochi: mod author * Chaosfun: testing and [video of older version](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qADctjYS5-w) * Maestro, Gagaxm, Obelix, Sunny Scunny: testing and feedback. * yenayang: technical advisor * Thanks to everyone who tested, supported, or guided development along the way! * Thumbnail photo: Toronto, Canada by [Alex Smith](https://unsplash.com/photos/time-lapse-photography-of-vehicles-in-busy-road-sRTLpqB5haw) * History and thanks to all past modders: SwiftCobra creator of the first speed mod (MIT license). It passed to Aberro's mod (MIT) and then to DanielVNZ's version (retired).
